name: theographic-bible-metadata
title: Theographic Bible Metadata
description: A knowledge graph of the Bible that links every verse of the King James Version (1769 Cambridge Edition) to the people, places, events, people groups, and Easton's Bible Dictionary entries it mentions: 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,102 verses, 3,067 people, 1,298 place records (1,030 distinct places), 450 events, 23 people groups, and 6,519 dictionary entries. Documentation: https://github.com/robertrouse/theographic-bible-metadata/tree/master/docs

sources.title: Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897), CCEL XML edition
Pleiades: A Gazetteer of Past Places
Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament

resources.name: books

resources.description: The 66 books of the Protestant canon: names, OSIS abbreviations, canonical divisions, writers, and chapter, verse, people, and place counts.

resources.name: people
resources.title: People
resources.description: Every individual named in the Bible (3,067 records), with family relationships, birth and death years and places, group membership, and the verses that mention them.

fields.name: personLookup
fields.description: Unique identifier using name and ID number

fields.name: personID
fields.description: Unique numerical identifier, helping to distinguish people with the same name.

fields.name: displayTitle
fields.description: Disambiguated name suitable for page titles and search results

fields.name: name
fields.description: Primary name used in the text of the KJV

fields.name: surname
fields.description: Surname, if known.

fields.name: alsoCalled
fields.description: Alternate spellings or other known names for the same person.

fields.name: isProperName
fields.description: `checked` for people with proper names, blank for descriptive names like "Wife of..." or "Son of..."

fields.name: ambiguous
fields.description: `checked` for display titles that have not yet been edited for disambiguation, otherwise blank.

fields.name: Disambiguation (temp)
fields.description: Mechanical Turk entries used to aid in disambiguation

fields.name: gender
fields.description: Male or Female

fields.name: occupations
fields.description: Reserved for future use; currently empty on every record.

fields.name: birthYear
fields.description: Estimated birth year from Jones's chronology, as an ISO 8601 astronomical year (`-4003` = 4004 BC; positive values are AD). Same convention as `events.startDate`. Populated for 70 people.

fields.name: minYear
fields.description: Earliest year of the verses that mention this person (ISO 8601). Used to align people with the events timeline; not a birth year.

fields.name: deathYear
fields.description: Estimated death year, in the same convention as `birthYear` (`-1014` = 1015 BC). Populated for 61 people.

fields.name: maxYear
fields.description: Latest year of the verses that mention this person (ISO 8601).

fields.name: birthPlace
fields.description: Where the person was born, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `egypt_362`).

fields.name: deathPlace
fields.description: Where the person died, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `mount_hor_842`).

fields.name: memberOf
fields.description: Groups (tribes, families, etc.) the person belongs to, as comma-separated `groupName` values (e.g. `Tribe of Levi`).

fields.name: eastons
fields.description: Matching Easton's Bible Dictionary entries, as comma-separated `dictLookup` values (e.g. `Aaron`).

fields.name: dictText
fields.description: Markdown-formatted text of the matching sub-section of Easton's Bible Dictionary.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Comma-separated titles of events the person took part in. Titles that contain commas are wrapped in double quotes.

fields.name: eventGroups
fields.description: Reserved for future use; currently empty on every record.

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Counts verses where the person is mentioned by name

fields.name: verses
fields.description: Every verse where this person is mentioned by name, as comma-separated verse `osisRef` values (e.g. `Exod.4.14`).

fields.name: mother
fields.description: The person's mother, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `jochebed_1645`).

fields.name: father
fields.description: The person's father, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `amram_242`).

fields.name: partners
fields.description: The person's spouse(s) or partner(s), as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `elisheba_1162`).

fields.name: children
fields.description: The person's children, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `abihu_33`).

fields.name: siblings
fields.description: The person's full siblings, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `miriam_2087`).

fields.name: halfSiblingsSameMother
fields.description: The person's maternal half-siblings, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `david_994`).

fields.name: halfSiblingsSameFather
fields.description: The person's paternal half-siblings, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `jeush_1603`).

fields.name: chaptersWritten
fields.description: Chapters attributed to this person, as comma-separated chapter `osisRef` values (e.g. `Prov.30`).

fields.name: alphaGroup
fields.description: Used for alphabetical indexing

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Lowercase, URL-friendly version of `personLookup`

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Last modified date and time in UTC, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` (e.g. `2026-10-23 04:46`).

resources.name: places

resources.description: Every biblical place record (1,298), with coordinates from OpenBible.info and Recogito, feature types, place-to-place relations, and the verses that mention them.

fields.name: placeLookup
fields.description: Unique identifier using name and ID number

fields.name: displayTitle
fields.description: Disambiguated name suitable for page titles and search results

fields.name: ambiguous
fields.description: `checked` for display titles that have not yet been edited for disambiguation, otherwise blank.

fields.name: placeID
fields.description: Unique numerical identifier, useful to separate places which share the same name

fields.name: kjvName
fields.description: Place name in the King James Version

fields.name: esvName
fields.description: Place Name in the English Standard Version (from OpenBible.info/geo)

fields.name: recogitoComments
fields.description: Notes on place assignments from Recogito

fields.name: featureType
fields.description: Broad classification such as City, Region, Water, Mountain. Populated for 744 of 1,298 place records.

fields.name: featureSubType
fields.description: A more specific classification of the featureType, such as "River" for the "Water" type.

fields.name: openBibleLat
fields.description: Latitude from OpenBible.info

fields.name: openBibleLong
fields.description: Longitude from OpenBible.info

fields.name: precision
fields.description: Relative accuracy of lat/long assignment

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Alternate names for the same coordinate

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Comments from OpenBible.info/geo

fields.name: verses
fields.description: Verses where this place is mentioned by name, as comma-separated verse `osisRef` values (e.g. `2Kgs.5.12`).

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Counts how many verses mention this place by name

fields.name: eastons
fields.description: Matching Easton's Bible Dictionary entries, as comma-separated `dictLookup` values (e.g. `Abana`).

fields.name: dictText
fields.description: Markdown-formatted text of the matching sub-section of Easton's Bible Dictionary.

fields.name: recogitoUri
fields.description: Links to an associated place in other historical databases

fields.name: recogitoLat
fields.description: Latitude from Recogito matches

fields.name: recogitoLon
fields.description: Longitude from Recogito matches

fields.name: peopleBorn
fields.description: People born here, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `chilion_940`).

fields.name: peopleDied
fields.description: People who died here, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `sheba_2570`).

fields.name: recogitoStatus
fields.description: Verification of links to other historical databases

fields.name: recogitoType
fields.description: Geographic type from Recogito matches

fields.name: recogitoLabel
fields.description: Title from Recogito matches

fields.name: recogitoUID
fields.description: Unique ID for importing Recogito records

fields.name: booksWritten
fields.description: Books written here, as comma-separated book `osisName` values (e.g. `Gal`).

fields.name: eventsHere
fields.description: Events that happened here, as comma-separated event titles (e.g. `Nimrod's kingdom begins`). Titles that contain commas are wrapped in double quotes.

fields.name: hasBeenHere
fields.description: A string containing a comma-separated list of `personLookup` identifiers for people who have visited this location.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Best available latitude, chosen from Recogito and OpenBible validation. Stored as a string; convert to a number before mapping. Present on 1,272 place records.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Best available longitude, depending on Recogito and OpenBible validation

fields.name: alphaGroup
fields.description: Used for alphabetical indexing

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Lowercase, URL-friendly version of `placeLookup`

fields.name: canonicalPlace
fields.description: The place this record is another name for (e.g. Salem -> Jerusalem); empty on canonical records, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `abel-beth-maacah_5`).

fields.name: otherNames
fields.description: On a canonical record, the records that are other names of this place, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `ebron_352`).

fields.name: partOf
fields.description: Places this place lies within: a city's tribal territory, a site's city, a city's Roman region, a territory's kingdom, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `asher_1287`).

fields.name: parts
fields.description: On a containing place, the places whose `partOf` points to it, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `athens_118`).

fields.name: near
fields.description: Places this place lies beside or just outside (Gethsemane -> Jerusalem), as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `jerusalem_636`).

fields.name: nearby
fields.description: The places whose `near` points to this place, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `allon-bacuth_48`).

fields.name: startYear
fields.description: For a place that existed only for a period, such as a kingdom, its first year (ISO astronomical: -1094 = 1095 BC). Dates every `partOf` link to it.

fields.name: endYear
fields.description: That place's last year, same numbering.

resources.name: events
resources.title: Events
resources.description: A timeline of 450 biblical events with dates, durations, predecessors, participants, locations, and verses. Old Testament and Gospel dates follow Floyd Nolen Jones; Acts dates follow Todd Atwood. Years are ISO 8601 astronomical years (-4003 = 4004 BC).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Unique title for an event

fields.name: eventID
fields.description: Unique identifier

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: An ISO 8601 astronomical year (`-4003` = 4004 BC) or calendar date (`0030-04-04`). Present on every event.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Event length: a number plus `D`, `W`, `M`, or `Y` (e.g. `7D`, `40Y`)

fields.name: predecessor
fields.description: The immediately preceding event in the timeline, as comma-separated event titles (e.g. `Creation of Adam and Eve`). Titles that contain commas are wrapped in double quotes.

fields.name: lag
fields.description: Time between the predecessor event and this one, in the same format as `duration` (e.g. `130Y`).

fields.name: lagType
fields.description: The type of predecessor relationship - either Start-to-Start (SS) or Finish-to-Start (FS). For example, for an event with lag of 130Y, lagType `FS` means that the event started 130 years after the predecessor event finished, whereas lagType `SS` means that the event started 130 years after the predecessor event started.

fields.name: partOf
fields.description: The parent event this event is part of, as comma-separated event titles (e.g. `Lifetime of Adam`). Titles that contain commas are wrapped in double quotes.

fields.name: verses
fields.description: The verses that describe this event, as comma-separated verse `osisRef` values (e.g. `Gen.1.1`).

fields.name: participants
fields.description: People who took part in the event, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `god_1324`).

fields.name: locations
fields.description: Where the event happened, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `eden_354`).

fields.name: groups
fields.description: People groups involved in the event, as comma-separated `groupName` values (e.g. `Nation of Israel`).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: A field for additional commentary or explanatory notes about the event.

fields.name: verseSort
fields.description: The `verseID` of the first verse in the `verses` field of this event.

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Last modified date and time in US Central time, formatted `MM/DD/YYYY h:mmam` (e.g. `10/22/2026 12:37am`). Note this differs from the UTC format used in the other CSV files.

fields.name: sortKey
fields.description: Uses a combination of year and verseSort to sort all events chronologically. The calculation formula, originated in airtable, is `INT(IF(LEFT(startDate,1)='-',LEFT(startDate,5),LEFT(startDate,4))) + INT(verseSort)/100000000`

resources.name: easton
resources.title: Easton's Bible Dictionary
resources.description: Entries from Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897), parsed from the CCEL XML edition and linked to people and places.

fields.name: dictLookup
fields.description: Unique string for a dictionary entry, split out by sub-paragraphs

fields.name: index
fields.description: Unique identifier

fields.name: termID
fields.description: The `id` of the term's `<term>` tag in the source XML, so each entry can be traced back to its place in the original (e.g. `a-p1.11`: section "a", paragraph block "p1", 11th tagged element).

fields.name: termLabel
fields.description: The title of the dictionary term being defined.

fields.name: dictText
fields.description: The full definition text for the term. This field may contain Markdown-style links and newline characters for paragraph breaks.

fields.name: itemNum
fields.description: Item number for a definition that is one of several numbered meanings of the same word (1.0, 2.0, 3.0...); 0.0 for entries that are not itemized. Written with a decimal in the CSV.

fields.name: matchType
fields.description: Used to validate scripts which automatically match entities.

fields.name: matchSlugs
fields.description: Used to check automatically matched slugs of entities in other tables

fields.name: personLookup
fields.description: People this entry describes, as comma-separated `personLookup` values (e.g. `aaron_1`).

fields.name: placeLookup
fields.description: Places this entry describes, as comma-separated `placeLookup` values (e.g. `abana_1`).

resources.name: word-index
resources.title: Word index
resources.description: One row per KJV word (about 790,000 rows) with its position, punctuation, italics, syllables, and the person, place, and year tied to it. Maintained by hand, not exported from Airtable.

fields.name: BookID
fields.description: Book number in canonical order (1 = Genesis).

fields.name: Chapter
fields.description: Chapter number.

fields.name: VerseID
fields.description: Sequential verse number.

fields.name: VerseNum
fields.description: Verse number within the chapter.

fields.name: Word
fields.description: The KJV word.

fields.name: Punc
fields.description: Punctuation following the word.

fields.name: Italic
fields.description: 1 if the word is italicized in the KJV (supplied by the translators), else 0.

fields.name: PlaceID
fields.description: placeID of the place this word refers to, or 0.

fields.name: Syllables
fields.description: Number of syllables in the word.

fields.name: YearNum
fields.description: Approximate year of the verse, ISO 8601 astronomical year (-4003 = 4004 BC).

fields.name: PersonID
fields.description: personID of the person this word refers to, or 0.
